supersedes.status: immutable and preserved; aborted after 3 of 30 requests (empty replies)

status: immutable once committed; changes require a new protocol id
reason: v1's generation settings (default reasoning, max_tokens 2200) produced HTTP 200 / finish_reason=length / null visible content on 3 of 3 requests (hidden reasoning exhausted the completion budget). v2 calibrates the generation settings on non-experimental pilot contexts, then runs the unchanged corrected experiment.

generation_diagnosis.source: Nebius Token Factory docs (create-chat-completion, structured output), read 2026-10-14
documented: reasoning_effort accepts none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max (no per-model behaviour is documented)
max_completion_tokens is documented as including visible and reasoning tokens; max_tokens is the generic limit
response_format json_object / json_schema exist; support is model dependent ('test and compare')
enable_thinking and chat_template_kwargs are not documented
consequences: accepted parameters are NOT assumed to be honoured: every call records the requested effort/max_tokens, finish_reason, completion tokens, reasoning_present and reported reasoning_tokens
structured-output modes are not part of the four preregistered settings and are not used

spend.note: the Nemotron token price was not verifiable from public docs; 5 USD per million tokens is a deliberately high assumed bound and the v1 tokens are included

calibration.contexts: derived from the designated pilot seeds 9500-9515: theta0 is run on those 16 seeds (a counted batch labelled calibration-context; the v1 pilot ran the same rollouts but did not store per-seed results); context = first 4 failing + first 2 walking seeds in ascending seed order; STOP if the pool has fewer; two prompts per setting: M (measured evidence) and N (control, byte-identical controller block and system prompt)
calibration.no_outcome_leakage: no R3 screening/validation outcome and no R2 final outcome is used; screening/validation seeds are not touched
calibration.procedure: sequential: for each setting in order make exactly one M and one N request (<= 8 requests in total); stop at the first passing setting; later settings are then not tested
calibration.pass_rule: a setting passes iff BOTH responses have non-null visible content, a valid JSON envelope and at least 2 schema-valid proposals each (r3.parse_proposal against the context shown)
calibration.selection: the FIRST passing setting in the prespecified order; proposal quality, physics, or how convincing an edit sounds play no part
calibration.if_none_passes: the statistical experiment is not run; the generation blocker is reported as the R3 result
recorded_per_request: model id reported by the API
calibration.freeze: generation_config.json (the selected setting + the observed calibration metadata) is committed before the first experimental request

same_as_v1: 15 frozen evidence contexts and prompt SHA-256 (contexts.json, commit 196de48)
screening seeds and theta0's derived screening baseline
4 slots per request, all-slot ITT endpoint, invalid/empty = failure
matched-random streams (SeedSequence([rng_base, 11|12, block, slot])) and fallback magnitudes
paired request-block exact sign-flip test (two-sided, alpha 0.05)
comparators frozen in candidates.json before any simulation
validation of the top-3 candidates per arm (descriptive)
experiment.generation: the SAME selected setting for the evidence and the no-evidence arm (reasoning_effort and max_tokens from generation_config.json); temperature 0.7
experiment.request_order: interleaved M0, N0, M1, N1, ... M14, N14
experiment.early_abort: if the first 4 experimental requests all return null visible content, stop and report a generation failure (protects the budget)
experiment.carryover: v1 pilot (96), evidence pool (180) and screen pool (64) rollouts are carried forward and NOT rerun; v1's three request records stay in results/requests.jsonl and count toward the combined caps; no v1 file is modified
experiment.completeness_rule: the primary test is run only if all 30 experimental requests were sent, none ended in a transport/HTTP error or budget refusal, the combined caps were respected and every frozen hash verified; otherwise the experiment is reported as incomplete
experiment.no_adaptation: no model physics outcome is inspected to change a prompt, a generation setting, a comparator or the analysis

reporting: no result is described as an AI success unless MuJoCo independently verifies the measured intervention; scripted replies are never saved as results
